releases.name: opencode-agent-harness 0.3.1 — sdlc handover build
releases.body:
# opencode-agent-harness 0.3.1 — `sdlc` handover build

Process/quality-only export of the harness for a closed / reviewed environment.
No npm registry access is needed: download the artifact, verify the hash, extract,
then run the org's scan before using it.

## Contents (123 files)

- 15 persona definitions, 17 skills, the operating rules and memory files
- 9 local OpenCode plugins (guards, freshness, todo sync)
- the process-gate scripts (backlog, gates, checkpoint, orient, …)
- `profile.json`, so `init` wires only the npm scripts whose files ship
- **not included:** deploy/CI, host tuning, mobile-E2E, `serve`/`nightly`,
  the board service, and repo tooling

No runtime dependencies, no npm lifecycle scripts, no telemetry, and no network
calls at install or init.

## Artifacts

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `agent-harness-0.3.1-sdlc-src.zip` | source snapshot (if archives are allowed) |
| `agent-harness-0.3.1-sdlc.tar.gz` | same tree as a gzip tarball |
| `agent-harness-0.3.1-sdlc.tar.gz.b64.txt` | base64 text, for scanners that block archives |
| `agent-harness-0.3.1-sdlc.part-*.txt` | the same base64 split into 64 KB parts |
| `MANIFEST.json` | every file with its SHA-256 |
| `REVIEW-NOTES.md` | one page for the security reviewer |
| `SHA256SUMS` | hashes of the bundle artifacts |

Tarball SHA-256:
`b12d040cd3cc18667142e6c8b4bf02db94d09b0a56ccbf0aa7fea1958be84139`

## Verify and install

```bash
# archives blocked? rebuild from the text parts
cat agent-harness-0.3.1-sdlc.part-*.txt | base64 -d > agent-harness-0.3.1-sdlc.tar.gz

sha256sum agent-harness-0.3.1-sdlc.tar.gz
mkdir agent-harness && tar xzf agent-harness-0.3.1-sdlc.tar.gz -C agent-harness

node agent-harness/bin/agent-harness.js init --target . --dry-run
node agent-harness/bin/agent-harness.js init --target . --yes
```

Built from commit `fbe24f3f90fe2ba76f87313e246c210131a1b8a7`.
